summary: The correctness leftovers of retro 0002 and the lines declined in the last two tasks. R-11: `tests_ran` reads `ok <pkg> … [no tests to run]` as none, a bare PASS is not a run (only `--- PASS:`), `no tests to run` is a no-run phrase. R-12: `_digest_in_index` queries a literal pathspec; the symlink key decodes with os.fsdecode on both sides. R-13 was already delivered (status reports attribution; its lock at the status test) — cited, not re-implemented. R-14: an executable regular file is keyed exec:<sha256> on disk, in the index and at HEAD; `same_key` accepts a bare hash already recorded. R-15: both CI workflows state which half of the gate a push job runs. Scaffold: thematic breaks are rules for the purpose draft; the CLAUDE.md pointer test is the marker, as migrate uses; the constitution's Amendment section matches its header; an in-checkout symlinked README is read. From STABLE-02 round 3: plan lists only names LENS_NAME accepts. Round 1: the go no-run lookahead spans the -cover text; the exec bit is keyed as git reads it (st_mode & 0o111) and not at all where core.fileMode is false, on both sides; the CLAUDE.md pointer marker is the import line, AGENTS.md's the bare path; only = and - underline a title; the architecture names the three key forms. Round 2: the key tests the owner's exec bit alone (mode & 0o100), which is the one git records, inside the try that guards the hash.
